model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models across multiple categories. The horizontal axis contains categories that are not explicitly labeled, while the vertical axis represents values ranging from 0 to a maximum value above 3, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals. Each category has six bars, representing mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in light blue, blue, green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. The bars have varying heights, with some having error bars extending above and below them. The pink and red bars tend to be among the tallest in most categories, while the green and dark green bars are generally shorter. No specific sorting or emphasis is apparent among the bars, and there is no explicit grouping or stacking beyond the side-by-side arrangement of the six bars per category.
